items.title: Cisco CEO on trusting Nvidia chips after Jensen Huang's exit: 'Absolutely'

items.title: 3 signs the AI trade is back
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor and Host of Sozzi Unleashed, Brian Sozzi shares three signs that the AI trade may be regaining momentum after a turbulent week. Earnings from Cisco (CSCO), Cerebras (CBRS), and CoreWeave (CRWV) are offering investors renewed optimism and signs of life in a beaten-down AI sector.

items.title: Three positive signs for the AI trade, America's inflation problem, and Huang's Nvidia departure
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi talks about the week to remember in the investing world, including Nvidia's (NVDA) Jensen Huang's departure, America's stubborn inflation problem, and positive signs that the AI trade is back. 

Sozzi is joined by former Medtronic (MDT) CEO Bill George, who grades the Nvidia board's makeup, its handling of Jensen Huang's departure, and its succession plan.
